title_zh: 靠纸条借伞的对门邻居
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (11/20): The Neighbor Across the Hall Who Lent Umbrellas by Note
note_en: Two neighbours who live door to door lend each other an umbrella and swap notes for months, but because of their different schedules they never meet. Then come more scenes from a Chinese housing compound (小区): the residents' WeChat group (业主群), balcony "deliveries" on ropes, an unofficial vegetable patch on the roof and the grannies on watch at the entrance.
